events.title: LTVA/TDVA/SLTTID Joint Boards Workshop
events.description: Thursday, April 30, 2026, 8:30 am – 1:00 pm, Lake Tahoe Visitors Authority (LTVA), the Tahoe Douglas Visitors Authority (TDVA), and the South Lake Tahoe Tourism Improvement District (SLTTID). Will meet at the Tahoe Blue Event Center.

events.title: Awe and then Some Forum – Tahoe Blue Event Center
events.description:
As LTVA marks its 40th anniversary this year, the Awe and then Some Forum is coming together as a dynamic convening of ideas, insight, and forward-looking strategy. Designed to spark meaningful conversation about the future of our destination, this year’s Forum will explore topics including:

  • Travel Nevada in Action: Adventure Centers, Strategic Partnerships & What it Means for Lake Tahoe
  • Taking Awe to the Next Level: Visit Lake Tahoe’s new campaign
  • Mountain Travel Update: Nimble Resilience Amid the Turmoil
  • Innovative Business Development Strategies in Changing Times TBD
  • And more!

The forum will be held on Tuesday, May 5, 2026, from 8:30 am to 1:30 pm at the Tahoe Blue Event Center. Doors open at 8:15 am for a continental breakfast, and the program begins at 8:45 am. Reserve your seat now here.  Admission costs $30 and includes breakfast, networking lunch, and parking.

More information here:
https://ltva.org/awe-and-then-some-forum/

events.title: Lake Tahoe Visitors Authority Marketing Services Committee Ac-Hoc Meeting
events.description:
The Lake Tahoe Visitors Authority Marketing Services Committee ad hoc meeting usually meets monthly from 10 am to 12 pm on the first Wednesday of the month at the Tahoe Blue Event Center, 75 Hwy 50, Stateline, NV 89449. Previous meeting notes.

This month’s meeting via Zoom, will focus on our upcoming marketing initiatives, with Noble Studios presenting the January–June 2027 paid media plan, our winter creative, and a proposed affordable lodging marketing strategy to increase visibility and support a segment of our South Shore lodging partners.

We will also provide a brief update on special events and other upcoming activities.

Meeting Details:

Date: Wednesday, November 4, 2026
Time: 10:00 a.m. Pacific
Location: Virtual via Zoom
Zoom Link: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/82231412481?pwd=g0AZOwFuUwNrnHSNTr2s2lO7DCkqjD.1
